item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Food is fuel for the day you're trying to build, and it works best when it's planned, not reactive. You've got a full schedule, so meals will get squeezed unless you decide them now. Pick a protein-forward lunch and a real dinner time, and don't let either slide into a snack. Eat slowly enough to notice when you're full. Your action: decide what lunch is right now, before the morning starts.
